ggcircos geoms, stats and positions

Source: R/geom-chord.R, R/geom-track-axis.R, R/geom-track.R, and 1 more
ggcircos-ggproto.Rd

The building blocks behind geom_chord(), geom_node_arc(), geom_track() and geom_track_axis(). Rarely needed directly: they are documented so that the layers' defaults and geometry can be looked up.

GeomPolygon needs nothing beyond x/y and a numeric group per polygon; the stat has already put the angles in drawing order.

GeomPath plus nothing: the stat has already placed every point, so the geom only has to draw the line. Kept as its own class (rather than a bare "path") so geom_track(geom = "density") can carry density defaults and so a future option has somewhere to live.

Developed by Guangchuang Yu, Shuangbin Xu.
